controles.affirmation: Environ 12 400 dossiers de prejudice corporel AFFF sont regroupes dans l'AFFF MDL auquel DuPont est partie ; procedures en cours de mediation
controles.verbatim_source: At June 30, 2026, there are approximately 12,400 personal injury cases filed in the AFFF MDL. ... The Company also continues to engage in discussions with a mediator in connection with these cases. (10-Q T2 2026, Note 13)
controles.correction_proposee: Exact, mais omission notable a ajouter pour l'equilibre : le meme paragraphe precise 'DuPont has never made or sold AFFF, PFOS or PFOS-containing products, and most of the actions in the AFFF MDL name DuPont as a defendant solely related to fraudulent transfer claims'.

controles.affirmation: Plusieurs procureurs d'Etats ont engage des actions distinctes pour contamination environnementale par des composes PFAS
controles.verbatim_source: Some state attorneys general have filed lawsuits, on behalf of their respective states, against DuPont, outside of the AFFF MDL that allege environmental contamination by certain PFAS compounds distinct from AFFF.

controles.affirmation: Plafond de depenses PFAS partage de 4 Mds $, part DuPont environ 1,4 Md $, deja payee a hauteur de 745 M$
controles.verbatim_source: the aggregate amount of Qualified Spend ... is equal to $4 billion ('MOU limit') ... subject to the MOU limit of $2 billion. ... the Company's portion of the $2 billion MOU limit is approximately $1.4 billion. At June 30, 2026, the Company had paid Qualified Spend of approximately $745 million
controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter le palier intermediaire : les 4 Mds $ sont le plafond global, dont 2 Mds $ pour DuPont+Corteva, dont ~1,4 Md $ pour DuPont.

controles.affirmation: Passifs d'indemnisation 614 M$ (31/12/2025) -> 723 M$ (30/06/2026) ; nouvelle provision 125 M$ Caroline du Nord au T2 2026 ; 188 M$ New Jersey ; paiement 875 M$ sur 25 ans
controles.verbatim_source: Total indemnification liabilities $723 / $614 ... As of June 30, 2026, the balance of this liability was $125 million [North Carolina] ... $188 million [New Jersey] ... an aggregate cash payment to the State of New Jersey of $875 million, payable over a period of 25 years
controles.correction_proposee: Pourrait mentionner que 44 % des obligations de financement du dossier Caroline du Nord sont contractuellement allouees a Qnity.

controles.affirmation: Le 10-Q T2 2026 reconnait explicitement que Chemours et Corteva pourraient ne pas etre en mesure d'honorer leurs obligations d'indemnisation ('there can be no assurance that any such third party would have adequate resources...', 10-Q T2 2026 Note 13 / Item 1A)
controles.verbatim_source: Le verbatim est ABSENT du 10-Q T2 2026. Il figure dans l'Item 1A du 10-K FY2025 (data-lake/DD/_risks_src.txt) : 'At December 31, 2025, the Company had recorded indemnification assets related to Stray Liabilities and other matters. There can be no assurance that any such third party would have adequate resources to satisfy its indemnification obligation when due'. Le seul passage nommant une contrepartie vise Qnity, pas Chemours ni Corteva.
controles.correction_proposee: Reecrire : 'Dans l'Item 1A de son 10-K 2025, DuPont indique qu'il n'existe aucune garantie qu'un tiers indemnisateur dispose des ressources suffisantes pour honorer son obligation, et que DuPont pourrait devoir en supporter temporairement le cout.' Retirer l'attribution au 10-Q T2 2026 et la designation nominative de Chemours et Corteva.
